limitations: The three-state labels are operational and protocol-dependent.
Independent validation is limited; do not claim universal accuracy.
The microscopy module is exploratory QC/morphology analysis, not a validated image-only state classifier.
Training-only refit behavior is implemented in the current core code; predictions on uploaded unlabeled data do not use its labels.
note: Prediction uses the frozen model when model-gene coverage meets the configured threshold. Below the threshold, the model refits only on stored training rank data and the overlapping model features; uploaded samples are not used as labelled training data.
